warnings: Optional configs/thesis_scenario.yaml is absent; using DetectorGeometry defaults only for documented detector constants.
Missing per-pair tolerance budget CSV; related figures of merit were skipped.
Per-pair omega and sigma_omega are unavailable; fractional uncertainty percentiles and robustness_index cannot be reported.
Current Phase B output stores grouped alpha and xy contributions; alpha_x, alpha_y, dx and dy cannot be split without a richer upstream table.
Phase C does not serialize the distance sweep values. sensitivity_range_exposure therefore plots stored Zagg versus exposure; it does not infer an exposure-versus-range curve.
F is not serialized; p95 nnz and voxel/track coverage fractions cannot be recovered from the Phase C report alone.
No reconstruction artifact was found; reconstruction FoMs remain future work.
No dedicated FUENTES/source-model output is currently exposed; source-model comparisons were not aggregated.
